long_biography.plain_text:
Taking control of Aker in 1996 transformed Kjell Inge Røkke from a fisheries entrepreneur into the principal behind an industrial investment group. His holding company RGI became Aker’s largest shareholder and later merged with it. As chair and controlling owner through TRG, he has directed long-term capital across energy, industrial technology, maritime services and marine biotechnology.

Røkke has committed most of his wealth to philanthropy focused on the oceans. He established and funded non-profit ocean-research and data organisations and became a patron of the UN Decade of Ocean Science. Through HUB Ocean, he serves as Special Emissary for Industrial Ocean Data and works to unlock company-held information for scientists and policymakers.
